{{Infobox Location |name = Charred Dungeon |image = [[File:Charred Dungeon.png|300px]] |release = [[19 November]] [[2025]] |update = Sailing is OUT TODAY! |members = Yes |location = [[Charred Island]] |requirement = {{SCP|Sailing|60}} |music = [[Lurking Threats]] |map = {{Map|mapID=-1|x=2684|y=8864|zoom=1|height=200}} |type = Dungeon |leagueRegion = No }} The '''Charred Dungeon''' is a [[List of dungeons|dungeon]] containing several [[Slayer monsters]] and other resources, including [[lava strykewyrm]]s. It is accessible by climbing down the [[Dark hole (Sailing)|dark hole]] on [[Charred Island]], which requires level 60 [[Sailing]] to dock at. [[Rope]] is required when entering the dungeon the first time. However, there is a rope item spawn on the island so one doesn't need to be brought to the island. If you teleport out of the dungeon, you will need to retrieve your boat via a [[Shipwright]], use one of the [[boat#Teleportation|boat teleportation]] spells, or be brought to the island by another player, as there is no other way to get to the island than with a player-owned ship. Two mining spots can be found in the dungeon; one to the south-west containing 10 coal, 3 adamantite and 2 runite rocks, and one to the south-central area containing 24 rubium rocks and 2 rubium deposits being mined by a dwarf named [[Kragin]]. [[Random events]] can not spawn inside the dungeon. {{Map|x=2647|y=2404|mtype=pin|2637,2416|align=left|caption=The entrance to the dungeon|icon=redPin}} == Features == The entire dungeon, barring the [[Lava Strykewyrm|lava strykewyrms]], is a [[multicombat area]]. A [[dwarf multicannon]] can be used throughout the dungeon, although it will not target the strykewyrms. * Mining rocks: ** 24 [[rubium rocks]] ** 2 [[rubium deposit]]s ** 10 [[coal rocks]] ** 3 [[adamantite rocks]] ** 2 [[runite rocks]] * Item spawns: ** [[Black dagger]] (near the black demons) ** [[Magic staff]] (near the black demons) ** 4 [[burnt bones]] (near the red dragons) * 1 [[Fishing spot (lava eel)|fishing spot]] for [[lava eel]]s * [[Old chest]] that can be opened with [[charred key]] to obtain [[Zamorakian paint]]s, located in the eastern half of the cave, south of the [[black demon]]s == Monsters == {{Map|mapID=-1|zoom=2|x=2684|y=8864|align=left|width=600|height=300|caption=Locations of monsters in the dungeon. |mtype:rstext,label:Fire Giants,fontsize:9pt,2636:8886 |mtype:rstext,label:Black
